prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1176; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver was named on the policy as a person who may NOT drive the car.
text: At an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, Driver 1 was proceeding through the junction when Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was assessed at the scene. Passenger was also seated in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the parties present confirmed that Passenger was in the car at the time of impact. No independent witnesses observed the collision. Scene photographs confirm several details of the vehicle positions, and the visible damage is largely consistent with the reported side impact. The policy on Driver 1's vehicle lists Driver 1 as a person who may not drive the car. Investigators found no evidence of earlier damage to the vehicle. It is not yet clear whether the knee injury resulted from this crash, and medical follow-up will be needed to determine the cause.
